text:
Alex: Heads up — staging p95 latency jumped to ~420ms over the last 6m, deploy-bot auto-paused the canary. What do we want to do? manual rollback, pin to previous build, or dig in?
Maria: saw the alert, logs look noisy around KV cache misses. not sure if rollback will help immediately.
deploy-bot: AUTOPAUSE: Canary rollout paused at 60% traffic. Trigger reason: p95_latency > 300ms for 5m. Suggested actions: [investigate, rollback, pin].
Jordan: if KV cache is the culprit a hotfix might be faster than full rollback. can we pin traffic to last stable model version while we patch?
Emily: agree with Jordan. pin to v2.7.1 for routing layer only, keep canary pods for debugging. notify customers in release notes?
Alex: timeline — pin takes ~2m to propagate. manual rollback is heavier and could cause more churn. who can run the pin?
Maria: I can run the pin now. running command: `redwoodctl release pin --env=staging --version=v2.7.1 --route=canary`
SRE_Oncall: leaving a note — if pin doesn't reduce p95 within 10m we should revert to rollback plan B (full revert). Also prepare postmortem doc stub.
Jordan: Maria ping me as you start. I'll tail the ingress and runtime logs for 10m. quick check: any schema/db changes in this deploy?
Emily: no schema migration. main changes: kernel selection tweak and a batching heuristic. suspect batching config interaction with short sequences.
deploy-bot: NOTE: when human confirms pin, autopause state will remain until manual resume. Use `redwoodctl rollout resume --manual` after cleanup.
Maria: pinned to v2.7.1, command returned 0. waiting for propagation (started 4259990125).
Alex: thanks. Jordan, Emily — start your tailing. SRE_Oncall please prep rollback playbook in case pinned route doesn't stabilize. I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for release notes and post in #customers if we need to notify.
Jordan: seeing p95 drop to 310 -> 260 in last 2m, KV miss rate still spiking but less.
Emily: good sign. keep monitoring for 10m window. also I pushed a debug flag to canary pods to capture batch sizes.
SRE_Oncall: rollback playbook ready: steps + owners + comm template. will open ticket and link to the thread shortly.
Alex: decision checklist for final call: 1) p95 <= 300 sustained for 10m -> keep pinned, roll forward fix in next patch; 2) p95 > 300 -> execute full rollback to prior image and notify customers.
Maria: after 8m p95 stabilized at ~240ms. I'll leave pin in place and coordinate cherry-pick hotfix branch.
Jordan: +1. I'll keep log streams open for 30m and watch for regressions after hotfix merge.
Emily: I'll start working on the batching heuristic rollback and test locally.
Alex: thanks team. I'll post a short summary to #release-updates and update the release notes draft: "Staging rollout paused and pinned due to latency spike; pinned to v2.7.1 while investigating batching heuristic; no customer impact observed so far." :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: REMINDER: manual pins should be recorded in release metadata. Use `redwoodctl release annotate --id=4259990000 --note="pinned due to staging p95"`
Maria: annotated. closing loop for now, will report back once hotfix candidate ready.
Alex: excellent. great coordination — keep comms short and flags obvious in the runbook.
